_note: Whitelist: only mods with an entry here are listed (key = folder name in the dev root, case-sensitive; use {} when there is nothing to override). Keys starting with _ are comments. Optional keys: enabled (false = parked: the entry and its metadata stay, the mod is not listed; true = list even when the Forge API reports the mod as published - otherwise such an entry is skipped with a warning), description (short text for the table), notes (extra hint for testers, Markdown), screenshots (paths relative to the mod folder; replaces the automatic selection), dependencies (array; either a Forge GUID string like 'com.anvil.weboverlay' - name and link are resolved via the Forge API - or an object {"name": ..., "url": ...} for dependencies not on Forge). Published detection: one query against https://sp-mod.com/api/v0/mods?filter[guid]=... using each mod's BepInPlugin GUID; result cached in forge-published.json.

AiStoryQuests.description: Experiment: AI-generated story quests (providers: OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama, own API key required).

BtrTurretControl.notes: You still have to pay for the taxi service to not get thrown out on departure

ClusterGrenade.description: Cluster grenade for SPT: instead of shrapnel, the explosion releases several impact bomblets. Also adds a 40mm cluster round and HE ammunition

ModSourceDebugger.description: Debugging tool: traces item templates and UI elements back to the mod that added them (tooltips + UI inspector).

SurroundAudio.description: Replaces Tarkov's binaural (headphone) audio with real 5.1/7.1 output, so you can play on a surround speaker system instead of headphones.
SurroundAudio.notes:
**Beta - feedback wanted.** Requires your Windows output device to be configured for the same layout (Configure Speakers > 5.1) with Windows Sonic/Atmos **off**.

When reporting, please include your speaker layout and how it is connected (HDMI to receiver / analog), plus the `maschine-SurroundAudio` lines from the BepInEx console. To verify your channels, bind `ChannelTestKey` in the F12 config menu and run the test.

Known: vertical cues (enemy above/below) are weaker than with binaural headphones - that is inherent to speaker playback, not a bug.

_parked: Parked entries (enabled: false): not listed, metadata kept. Remove "enabled" to list the mod again.

CombatSlide.description: Press crouch while sprinting to keep sliding at decreasing speed - a "combat slide" like in other shooters.

CorpseRun.description: After dying in a raid, optionally respawn (naked), loot your own corpse and continue the raid; giving up ends the raid normally.

Killcam.description: "Killcam light": on death the camera switches to the killer's first-person view for about 6 seconds; the death panel shows the killer's name and remaining HP.
Killcam.notes: Predecessor of **KillcamReplay** - do not install both at the same time.

KillcamReplay.description: True killcam: on death, the killer's final moments are replayed from their point of view, based on the recorded movement of the last seconds before the kill.
KillcamReplay.notes: Successor of **Killcam** - do not install both at the same time.

ModProfiler.description: In-game profiler modeled after Dubs Performance Analyzer (RimWorld): shows live how much CPU time each installed client mod costs per frame – find the cause of performance drops without disabling mods one by one.
